overview:
Representative Mark Takano, a Democrat, seeks another term in this Riverside County district, which leans Democratic by seven points on the partisan index. He faces Republican Steve Manos, who has raised roughly eleven thousand dollars and entered the general election with under four thousand dollars on hand. Takano has raised more than one million dollars and holds over two hundred thirty thousand for the final stretch, an advantage of roughly one hundred to one.

No independent polls or expert ratings are available for the race, so the outlook rests on the district's fundamentals, the incumbency, and the lopsided money gap. Prediction markets price the Democratic side at about ninety-eight percent. The combined evidence points to a margin near twenty points and places the seat firmly in the Safe Democratic column, with the incumbent's financial dominance the clearest signal available.
